svg.title: 2O and 2I: two distinct exceptional completions of the 24-element Hurwitz core 2T
svg.desc: Left: a two-dimensional projection of the 48 quaternionic elements of binary octahedral 2O, with 24 shared Hurwitz elements in gold and 24 complementary elements in mint. Right: a projection of 120 unit quaternions of binary icosahedral 2I, the vertices of the 600-cell, with its 720 exact nearest-neighbour edges. The common Hurwitz core has 24 vertices. The fork does not embed 2O inside 2I.
svg.text: One Hurwitz core, two exceptional extensions
Unit quaternions on S³ · exact support counts · projected four-dimensional structures
Geometric illustration using exact Paper I-B quaternion coordinates; the 2D view is a projection, not a literal embedding of the four-dimensional cells.
